config.hypothesis: Measure the combined contribution of codebook cleaning and exclusions at fixed Phase 14 model parameters and nested threshold protocol, against all 321 unmodified predictors.

missing_values.method: All raw float32 CSV predictors and NaNs unchanged; no semantic cleaning or exclusions.

threshold.selection_method: pooled outer OOF F1; exploratory unless nested_threshold_evaluation is present

memory_estimate.basis: Largest raw float32 train/validation pair in one process; excludes worker concurrency and temporary arrays.

nested_threshold_evaluation.protocol: Each outer-fold threshold is selected from inner OOF probabilities fitted and preprocessed only on that outer fold's training rows.

provenance.elapsed_basis: Original log rounded to 0.1s; otherwise wall time unavailable.
Original log rounded to 0.1s; otherwise wall time unavailable.

parallel_resume.runtime_scope: Resume wall time; excludes earlier sequential reused training. Per-fit profiles distinguish historical and new work.

preprocessing_benchmark.interpretation: Joint effect of base cleaning and exclusions; 128/321 versus 128/295 candidate fraction. Does not isolate individual preprocessing operations.
preprocessing_benchmark.raw_policy: All parsed CSV predictors; original finite codes and NaNs unchanged; no fill, scaling, recoding, exclusions or extra features. Training-fitted histogram bins and missing routing remain model components.
preprocessing_benchmark.scope: One full preprocessing ablation; model, data and folds fixed.

outcome.runtime_basis: Resume wall time; excludes earlier sequential reused training. Per-fit profiles distinguish historical and new work.
outcome.selection_note: Pooled OOF F1 uses the same labels to select and describe its threshold. Use nested_threshold_evaluation, when configured, for an unbiased threshold result.
